stemMd: A committee of 3 people is chosen from 5 women and 4 men. How many committees contain exactly 2 women?
explanationMd: Choose two women in C(5,2) = 10 ways, then one man in 4 ways. The independent choices multiply to 40 committees. No ordering of members is specified, so permutations would overcount the same committee.

distractorRationale.a: This undercounts the choices of two women or of one man.
distractorRationale.c: This does not use the correct combination count for two women.
distractorRationale.d: This counts the two selected women in both orders.
distractorRationale.e: This treats the three committee positions as ordered.
